run_lightning_attention: run lightning attention on query, key, value tensors with decay rate and optional kv_history
run_linear_decode_forward_triton: run linear attention decoding with kv cache using Triton kernels for single token generation
run_BailingLinearKernel_jit_linear_forwa: run BailingLinearKernel jit linear forward prefix with query, key, value, kv cache and slope rate
run__attention_forward: run the _attention autograd function forward pass for lightning attention with q, k, v, s and kv_history
run__attention_backward: run the _attention autograd function backward pass for lightning attention gradient computation
